_readme: Outside resources shown in the Resource Library. area: local (Miami-Dade) | southFlorida | florida | national | general. 'checked' = date the link and details were last verified. Set verified:false to hide an entry from the live site.

resources.title: Miami-Dade Animal Services
resources.summary: The county's public shelter and animal control. Report strays, search for lost pets and adopt. Main shelter: 3599 NW 79 Ave, Doral. Call ahead for hours.
resources.keywords: shelter animal control county doral mdas adopt

resources.title: MDAS Lost & Found Pets
resources.summary: How to report a found pet (required in Miami-Dade) and search for a lost one, including the county's online report form.
resources.keywords: report found lost form petco love lost

resources.title: Report a stray dog (MDAS)
resources.summary: Ask Animal Services to pick up a stray dog. Dogs on an expressway: Florida Highway Patrol, *347.

resources.title: Broward County Animal Care: Lost & Found
resources.summary: Broward's shelter in Fort Lauderdale. Report lost or found pets and check the shelter. Holds pets with ID 5 days, without ID 3 days.

resources.title: Palm Beach County Animal Care & Control
resources.summary: Palm Beach County's shelter in West Palm Beach, with online lost and found dog reports.

resources.title: MDAS foster program
resources.summary: Foster a dog for the county shelter. MDAS provides training and supplies; check the page for current requirements.

resources.title: MDAS low-cost vaccine clinic
resources.summary: Walk-in vaccines and microchips at the county shelter, with reduced prices for people on public benefits.
resources.keywords: vaccine rabies microchip cheap low cost

resources.title: MDAS spay/neuter
resources.summary: Low-cost spay and neuter for Miami-Dade residents at clinics in Doral and Homestead. Free for veterans with a DD-214.
resources.keywords: spay neuter sterilize low cost veterans

resources.title: ASPCA Community Veterinary Clinic, Liberty City
resources.summary: Lower-cost exams, vaccines, spay/neuter and microchips for Miami-Dade residents, with a discounted tier for people on benefits.
resources.keywords: vet clinic cheap liberty city aspca

resources.title: Humane Society of Greater Miami: preventive care
resources.summary: Vaccines, exams and preventives (not treatment for sick or injured animals). By appointment or walk-in.

resources.title: Miami-Dade dog license
resources.summary: Dogs over four months need a county license tag and a current rabies vaccine. Buy at the shelter, vets or 311 service centers.

resources.title: Report animal cruelty (MDAS)
resources.summary: Report neglect or cruelty to Animal Services. If cruelty is happening right now, call 911.

resources.title: Miami-Dade State Attorney: Animal Cruelty Unit
resources.summary: The prosecutors' unit for animal cruelty cases in Miami-Dade.

resources.title: Miami-Dade pet-friendly evacuation centers
resources.summary: What to bring and the rules for evacuating with pets during a hurricane. No pre-registration required.

resources.title: Florida Division of Emergency Management: Make a Pet Plan
resources.summary: Florida's guide to a pet disaster kit and evacuation plan.

resources.title: Petco Love Lost
resources.summary: Free lost and found pet database with photo matching, used by Miami-Dade Animal Services and thousands of shelters.

resources.title: AAHA microchip registry lookup
resources.summary: Enter a chip number to see which registry holds it. It doesn't show owner details; you contact the registry.

resources.title: ASPCA Animal Poison Control Center
resources.summary: Open 24/7 for possible poisonings. A consultation fee may apply.

resources.title: Pet Poison Helpline
resources.summary: 24/7 poison advice line staffed by veterinary experts. A per-incident fee applies.

resources.title: AVMA: First aid tips for pet owners
resources.summary: Veterinarians' guidance on handling and transporting an injured animal safely.
resources.keywords: injured hurt first aid muzzle transport

resources.title: American Red Cross: pet disaster preparedness
resources.summary: What to pack in a pet emergency kit and how to plan ahead.

resources.title: Pet Help Finder
resources.summary: Search by ZIP code for local help with vet costs, food and other pet needs.

resources.title: RedRover Relief
resources.summary: Grants toward urgent, life-threatening vet care for pet owners, Good Samaritans and rescuers. Check current eligibility.

resources.title: Humane World for Animals: trouble affording your pet?
resources.summary: A list of national financial-aid groups, payment plans and other options.
resources.keywords: financial help vet bills payment plan

resources.title: ASPCA: common dog behavior issues
resources.summary: Free articles on barking, chewing, resource guarding, separation anxiety and more.

resources.title: CCPDT certified trainer directory
resources.summary: Find a certified professional dog trainer near you by ZIP code.

resources.title: AVSAB position statements
resources.summary: Veterinary behaviorists on humane, reward-based training and how to choose a trainer.

resources.title: Maddie's Fund: fostering shelter dogs
resources.summary: What fostering a shelter dog usually involves, and what organizations typically cover.

resources.title: Humane World for Animals: puppy mills
resources.summary: How puppy mills work and how to avoid supporting them.
resources.keywords: puppy mill pet store breeder adopt dont shop
